name: button-group
useFor: Use for a set of related actions or a split key (an action and its options), a field with a fixed unit or prefix (ButtonGroupText), or a vertical zoom pair on a map. Nest groups for 8px between sets.
constraints: Rounded or separately cut keys inside one bar
Mixing filled and framed keys in one bar
A group of more than five keys (use a Select or a menu)
source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Buttons" (442:3) and "UI · Inputs" (442:107); the design has no joined keys
title: Button group
description: Keys joined into one bar: the first keeps the cut corner, the others square off and share a 1px line. Holds fields, selects and a Fog text segment for a fixed prefix or suffix.
